interface.signature: def isCircle(N: int, A: List[str]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of strings N must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 20 for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array A must have a length between 1 and 20.
The length of the array A must be equal to N.

postconditions.description: The function must return either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(s[-1] == A[(i + 1) % N][0] for i in range(N)) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The function returns 1 if the strings can form a circle, otherwise it returns 0.
